questions.question: What was the theme of the 77th Republic Day of India parade in 2026?

options.text: Amrit Kaal: The Rise of Bharat

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**150 years of Vande Mataram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Republic Day Celebrations 2026 at Kartavya Path on January 26, 2026, **were announced** to be a unique blend of **150 years of the national song ‘Vande Mataram’**, India’s military might, and cultural diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **150 years of Vande Mataram was chosen as the central theme of the parade. A series of paintings created by Shri Tejendra Kumar Mitra in 1923, illustrating the verses of ‘Vande Mataram’, were selected to be displayed as view-cutters along Kartavya Path.**
 
• A banner depicting ‘Vande Mataram’ **was planned** to be unveiled along with the release of rubber balloons at the conclusion of the parade, and floral decorations in front of the rostrum **were designed** to follow this theme.
 
• Pan-India band performances on the theme ‘Vande Mataram’ **were scheduled** to be organized from January 19 to 26, 2026, including venues like the ancestral home of Rishi Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay at Naihati, West Bengal.
 
• The Tableaux **were designated** to be presented under the broader themes **“Swatantrata ka Mantra – Vande Mataram”** and **“Samriddhi ka Mantra – Atmanirbhar Bharat”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chief Guests**__

 __
 
• President of the European Council **Mr. Antonio Costa** and President of the European Commission **Ursula von der Leyen** **were invited** as the Chief Guests for the Republic Day Parade 2026.
 
 
 
• **Military Display**__
 __
 
• The Indian Army **was set** to showcase a **Battle Array Formation** for the first time.
 
• The parade **was scheduled** to feature a Mounted Column of 61 Cavalry and various mechanized columns including T-90 and Main Battle Tank Arjun.
 
 
 
• **Tableaux and Guests**__
 __
 
• A total of **30 Tableaux** (17 from States/UTs and 13 from Ministries/Departments/Services) **were selected** to roll down Kartavya Path.
 
• Around **10,000 Special Guests** from various walks of life, including beneficiaries of schemes like PM SMILE and PM Vishwakarma, **were identified and invited**.
 
 
 
• **Fly-past**__
 
 
• A total of 29 Aircraft of the Armed forces **were confirmed** to participate in various formations, including Rafale, Su-30, and Apache helicopters.

questions.question: Project Veer Gatha, aimed at inspiring children about the gallant deeds of the Armed Forces, was jointly initiated by which two Union Ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Education
Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence
Ministry of Culture and Ministry of Defence
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and Ministry of Defence

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• **Project Veer Gatha 5.0 was jointly organised by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Defence as part of Republic Day celebrations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Project Veer Gatha 5.0 was conducted from 08 September 2025 to 10 November 2025.**
 
• **The initiative was jointly undertaken by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Defence.**
 
• It aimed to inspire school children about the bravery and sacrifices of India’s Armed Forces.
 
• Approximately 1.92 crore school students participated across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Project Veer Gatha** is a nationwide initiative to inculcate values of patriotism and courage among students.
 
• **Ministry of Education** oversees school education and student engagement programmes in India.
 
• **Ministry of Defence** plays a key role in preserving and promoting the legacy of the Armed Forces.
 
• **Selected student winners** of Veer Gatha 5.0 were felicitated in New Delhi and attended the Republic Day Parade.

questions.question: An indigenous Indian weapon system, termed “Suryastra,” was showcased for the first time at the Republic Day Parade 2026. What is Suryastra?

options.text: A next-generation high-altitude light battle tank
A hypersonic long range anti-ship missile
An multi-calibre long-range rocket launcher system
An advanced towed artillery gun system

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**An indigenous multi-calibre long-range rocket launcher system.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The indigenous weapon system “Suryastra” was showcased for the first time at the Republic Day Parade 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Suryastra is India’s first indigenous multi-calibre, long-range rocket launcher system.**
 
• It enhances the Indian Army’s deep-strike capabilities with ranges of 150 km and 300 km.
 
• The system features high precision with less than 5 metre Circular Error Probable and shoot-and-scoot capability.
 
• Suryastra has been developed by Pune-based NIBE Ltd. in collaboration with Israel’s Elbit Systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Rocket launcher systems** provide rapid, long-range firepower for saturation and precision strikes.
 
• **Shoot-and-scoot capability** allows launchers to relocate quickly after firing to avoid enemy counter-attacks.
 
• **Indigenous defence manufacturing** supports India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat and defence export ambitions.
 
• **Republic Day Parade** serves as a platform to showcase India’s latest defence capabilities and innovations.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Mission Divyastra:

1. Mission Divyastra is the first flight test of an indigenously developed Agni-V missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-Entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology by India’s Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO).

2. MIRV is a type of missile technology that allows a single missile to carry multiple nuclear warheads, each of which can be directed to a different target. 

3. Agni-V is an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) with a confirmed range of over 5,000 kilometers

How many of the above statement/s is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __option 3.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Hindu:** India test-fires Agni-V ballistic missile with multiple warhead technology under Mission Divyastra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****Mission Divyastra:**

__
 
• **Mission Divyastra **is the first flight test of an** indigenously developed Agni-5 missile equipped with MIRV technology by India’s Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO).* Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• MIRV stands for **Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle**. It’s a type of missile technology that allows a single missile to carry multiple nuclear warheads, each of which can be directed to a different target. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
 
• This technology significantly increases the effectiveness and destructive capability of ballistic missiles.
 
 
 
• **Basics of MIRV:**
 
 
• **Multiple Warheads:** Unlike older missile designs that carry a single nuclear warhead, a MIRV-equipped missile can carry several warheads, often up to a dozen or more. Each of these warheads can be assigned a different target.
 
• **Independently Targetable:** The key feature of MIRV technology is that each warhead can be directed to a different target independently of the others. This is achieved through sophisticated guidance and delivery systems.
 
• **Re-entry Vehicle: **After the missile is launched and reaches a certain point in its trajectory, the warheads are released. Each warhead is housed in its re-entry vehicle, which protects it as it re-enters the Earth’s atmosphere. The re-entry vehicle is designed to withstand the intense heat and friction generated during re-entry.
 
 
 
• **Agni V :**
 
 
• Agni-V is an **intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) developed by India’s Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) **and is the successor to the Agni-III missile.
 
• **Range:** Agni-V has a **confirmed range of over 5,000 kilometers**, with some reports suggesting 7,000 kilometers. This extended range places significant parts of Asia and Europe within its reach, allowing India to target all of China from bases located in central and southern India. * Hence, statement 3 is correct.*
 
• **Propulsion and Stages:** It is a three-stage missile that uses solid fuel for propulsion. The use of composite motor casing in the second and third stages helps reduce the missile’s weight, enhancing its range and payload capacity.
 
• **Mobility and Deployment:** Agni-V is designed for road mobility, using a canister-launch system. This feature significantly increases its operational flexibility and reduces reaction times for launch, as it can be fired from a pre-surveyed launch location without the need for a pre-built launch site.
 
• **Guidance and Control:** The missile employs an advanced guidance system, including a ring laser gyroscope-based inertial navigation system (RLG-INS) and a micro inertial navigation system (MINGS) as a backup. These systems are capable of interacting with both Indian and non-Indian satellite navigation systems, ensuring high accuracy.
 
• **MIRV Capability:** Agni-V is expected to feature Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicles (MIRVs), allowing a single missile to carry multiple nuclear warheads, each capable of striking different targets.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae49fa41522275641ec0c9c18dc50168e20646b93df68a7a8c0b6ecc05b57350.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Agni missiles are l**ong-range, nuclear weapons capable of surface-to-surface ballistic missiles**.
 
• The first missile of the series,** Agni-I** was developed under the** Integrated Guided Missile Development Program (IGMDP) **and** tested in 1989.**
 
• After its success, the **Agni missile program** was **separated from the IGMDP **upon realizing its strategic importance.
 
• It was designated as a** special program in India’s defense budget and provided adequate funds for subsequent development.**
 
• **Variants of Agni missiles:**
 
 
• **Agni I: **It is a **Medium Range Ballistic Missile** with a range of **700-800 km.**
 
• **Agni II:** It is also a **Medium Range Ballistic Missile **with a range of more than** 2000 km.**
 
• **Agni III:** It is also an **Inter-Medium Range Ballistic Missile **with a range of more than** 2,500 Km**
 
• **Agni IV:** It is also an** Inter-Medium Range Ballistic Missile **with a Range is more than** 3,500 km **and can fire from a** road mobile launcher.**
 
• **Agni-V:** Currently it is the longest of the Agni series, an **Inter-Continental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) with a range of over 5,000 km.**
 
• **Agni- VI:** The longest of the Agni series, an ICBM with a range of** ICBM 11,000–12,000 km**.

questions.question: In which of the following sessions of Congress did the Party issue a call to celebrate 26th January as 'Purna Swaraj Day'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore 1929**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The resolution to celebrate 26th January as 'Purna Swaraj Day' (Complete Independence Day) was passed during the **Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress in December 1929**.
 
• The session was presided over by **Jawaharlal Nehru**, who played a key role in the declaration of Purna Swaraj.
 
• The Congress declared **complete independence (Purna Swaraj) as its ultimate goal**, rejecting the dominion status proposed by the British government.
 
• It was decided that 26th January 1930 would be observed as **Independence Day**, and the day was marked by public meetings and the reading of the Purna Swaraj pledge.
 
• This event laid the foundation for India’s quest for independence, and later, the Constitution of India came into effect on 26th January 1950, marking it as Republic Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purna Swaraj Declaration:**

 
 
• The resolution for complete independence was a reaction to the British government's failure to meet the demands of the Nehru Report (1928).
 
• The declaration affirmed India's determination to fight for complete freedom from colonial rule.
 
• The Purna Swaraj pledge emphasized civil disobedience as a means to achieve independence.
 
 
 
• **Lahore Session of 1929:**
 
 
• This session of the Congress was significant as it marked a shift from dominion status to complete independence as the goal of the freedom struggle.
 
• It was held on the banks of the Ravi River in Lahore (now in Pakistan).
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was elected the president of the session, underscoring his rising prominence in the freedom movement.
 
 
 
• **26th January in Indian History:**
 
 
• The date was chosen to signify the importance of the Purna Swaraj resolution.
 
• Post-independence, the date was adopted as the day when the Indian Constitution came into effect in 1950, making India a sovereign, democratic republic.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Purna Swaraj Resolution:**
 
 
• The resolution galvanized the Indian population, especially the youth, towards the struggle for complete independence.
 
• It marked the beginning of mass participation in anti-colonial movements like the Civil Disobedience Movement (1930).
